## John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. and Eagle Financial Services, Inc. Announce Receipt of Shareholder Approvals for Merger


November 19, 2026


RESTON, Va. & BERRYVILLE, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[John Marshall Bancorp, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.johnmarshallbank.com%2F&esheet=54644244&newsitemid=20261119777648&lan=en-US&anchor=John+Marshall+Bancorp%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=220f8a1dabab2b4c5c113981ec9315af) (Nasdaq: JMSB) (“John Marshall”), the parent company of John Marshall Bank, and[Eagle Financial Services, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bankofclarke.bank%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54644244&newsitemid=20261119777648&lan=en-US&anchor=Eagle+Financial+Services%2C+Inc.&index=2&md5=392b819e21b550c9ff6ce3d8fb8e2314) (Nasdaq: EFSI) (“EFSI”), the parent company of Bank of Clarke, today jointly announced that shareholders of both companies have approved all proposals submitted at their respective special meetings of shareholders related to the previously announced transaction to merge EFSI with and into John Marshall.


The transaction remains subject to approval by the Virginia Bureau of Financial Institutions, a division of Virginia State Corporation Commission, along with the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. To date, the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond approved the application to merge Bank of Clarke with and into John Marshall Bank and also waived any application under the Bank Holding Company Act with respect to the transaction.


John Marshall and EFSI announced the signing of a definitive merger agreement on September 8, 2026. Upon completion, the combined company will have approximately $4.3 billion in total assets, positioning John Marshall as one of the leading community banks in a franchise extending from the nation’s capital to the Shenandoah Valley.


**About John Marshall Bancorp, Inc.**


John Marshall Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: JMSB) is the parent company of John Marshall Bank, a Virginia state-chartered bank headquartered in Reston, Virginia. John Marshall Bank serves businesses, professional service firms, non-profits and individuals throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area through eight full-service branches located in Alexandria, Arlington, Loudoun, Prince William, Reston, and Tysons, Virginia, as well as Rockville, Maryland, and Washington, D.C. As of September 30, 2026, John Marshall Bancorp had total assets of $2.4 billion, total loans of approximately $2.0 billion and total deposits of approximately $2.1 billion.


**About Eagle Financial Services, Inc.**


Eagle Financial Services, Inc. (Nasdaq: EFSI) is the parent company of Bank of Clarke, a Virginia state-chartered bank established in 1881 and headquartered in Berryville, Virginia. Bank of Clarke serves customers from the Shenandoah Valley to Northern Virginia through 14 full-service branches, a drive-through facility and a loan production office in Rockville, Maryland, and offers community banking, wealth management, and mortgage and SBA banking services. As of September 30, 2026, Eagle Financial Services had total assets of $1.9 billion, total deposits of $1.6 billion and gross loans of $1.5 billion, and its wealth management business had approximately $602 million in assets under management.


**Additional Information About the Proposed Transaction and Where to Find It**


In connection with the proposed transaction between John Marshall and EFSI, John Marshall filed with the SEC a registration statement on Form S-4 (File No. 333-299276) on October 2, 2026, as amended (the “Registration Statement”), which includes the joint proxy statement of John Marshall and EFSI that also constitutes a prospectus of John Marshall (the “Definitive Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus”). The Registration Statement was declared effective on October 16, 2026, and each of John Marshall and EFSI commenced mailing of the Definitive Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus to their respective shareholders on or about October 16, 2026. Each of John Marshall and EFSI may file with the SEC other relevant documents concerning the proposed transaction.


INVESTORS AND SHAREHOLDERS OF JOHN MARSHALL AND EFSI AND THEIR RESPECTIVE AFFILIATES ARE URGED TO READ CAREFULLY AND IN THEIR ENTIRETY THE REGISTRATION STATEMENT, THE DEFINITIVE JOINT PROXY STATEMENT/PROSPECTUS, AND ANY OTHER RELEVANT DOCUMENTS FILED OR TO BE FILED WITH THE SEC IN CONNECTION WITH THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION, AS WELL AS ANY AMENDMENTS OR SUPPLEMENTS TO THOSE DOCUMENTS, BECAUSE THEY CONTAIN OR WILL CONTAIN IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT JOHN MARSHALL, EFSI AND THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION.


Investors and shareholders are able to obtain a free copy of the Registration Statement, the Definitive Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus, and other relevant documents filed with the SEC containing information about John Marshall and EFSI, without charge, at the SEC’s website,[www.sec.gov.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2F&esheet=54644244&newsitemid=20261119777648&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov.&index=3&md5=966e8fe90fa1369ece7ab0352c5e4dc3) Copies of documents filed with the SEC by John Marshall will be made available free of charge in the “Investor Relations” section of John Marshall’s website,[investor.johnmarshallbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.johnmarshallbank.com&esheet=54644244&newsitemid=20261119777648&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.johnmarshallbank.com&index=4&md5=38d95b32bbaaa67fbbe64b45ef012ec9) , or can be obtained by requesting by mail at John Marshall Bancorp, Inc., 1943 Isaac Newton Square East, Suite 100, Reston, Virginia 20190, Attention: Corporate Secretary. **No Offer or Solicitation**


This communication does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any securities or a solicitation of any vote or approval with respect to the proposed transaction, nor shall there be any sale of securities in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such jurisdiction. No offer of securities shall be made except by means of a prospectus meeting the requirements of Section 10 of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.
